# mewa_ui

> Standalone monochrome component library built with semantic HTML, vanilla CSS, optional JavaScript, and a local Lucide SVG sprite. No Tailwind or framework dependency.

## Canonical files

- Production styles, in order: `/ui/src/base.css`, `/ui/src/mewa.css`
- Progressive enhancement: `/ui/src/components.js`
- Local icons: `/ui/src/lucide.svg#SYMBOL_ID`
- Public component inventory: `/ui/catalog/components.json`
- Complete examples: `/ui/snippets/SLUG.html`
- Expanded vertical application layout: `/ui/layouts/vertical-navbar.html`
- Vertical layout with right utility rail: `/ui/layouts/vertical-navbar-utility-end.html`
- Vertical layout with left utility rail: `/ui/layouts/vertical-navbar-utility-start.html`
- Collapsed vertical application layout: `/ui/layouts/vertical-navbar-collapsed.html`
- Horizontal application layout: `/ui/layouts/horizontal-navbar.html`
- Catalog-only styles: `/ui/src/demo.css` (do not load in consuming applications)

## Integration contract

1. Read `catalog/components.json` to choose a component by purpose, group, and behavior.
2. Open the matching snippet and copy only content between `<!-- mewa-ui-snippet:start -->` and `<!-- mewa-ui-snippet:end -->`.
3. Preserve native elements, labels, ids, `aria-*` relationships, live regions, and `data-ui-*` hooks.
4. Replace example content and ids as needed, keeping every reference unique and valid.
5. Do not invent `ui-*` classes, `data-ui-*` hooks, palette-step usage, or external icon dependencies.
6. Static components need only the production styles. Interactive components also need `components.js`; it enhances on load.
7. For dynamically inserted markup call `MewaUI.enhance(container)`. Before permanently removing an enhanced subtree call `MewaUI.destroy(container)`.

## Visual contract

- Geist Mono first: `geist_mono, ui-monospace, monospace`.
- Square, border-led, shadow-free geometry.
- Blur only for surfaces that overlap content.
- Six theme-specific 11-step OKLCH role palettes (`050`–`950`): gray, alpha white, alpha black, red, amber, green. Do not reverse them to synthesize a light theme.
- `050`–`200` are surfaces; `300`–`400` interactive foundations; `500`–`600` borders; `700`–`800` disabled/decorative content; `900` secondary text; `950` primary text.
- Opaque palettes share an APCA luminance curve. Text steps reach at least `Lc 75` and `Lc 90` against every `050`–`200` surface. APCA is design guidance, not a compliance claim.
- Components consume semantic roles from `base.css`; red, amber, and green communicate status. Derive hover/pressed values from semantic roles with the supplied relative-OKLCH modifiers instead of selecting another palette step.
- Use `--ui-border-dashed` for structural section division.
- Ghost buttons have no border or fill at rest.
- Lucide icons use the local sprite and `currentColor`. Decorative SVGs are `aria-hidden="true"`; icon-only controls require an accessible name.

## Consolidated patterns

- Alert includes inline status and blocking confirmation variants.
- Progress includes task progress and bounded native meter examples.
- Navbar Vertical replaces the former Sidebar component.
- Button Group may use the internal grouped-toggle behavior; Toggle Group is not a public component.

## Removed public components

Bubble, Context Menu, Direction/RTL demo, Dock, Hover Card, Input OTP, Menubar, Navigation Menu, Rating, Sidebar, Steps, Toggle Group, Toolbar.

## Accessibility

Keep native form submission and fallback behavior. Do not remove captions, legends, explicit labels, descriptions, focusability, `aria-live` output, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-selected`, or keyboard instructions present in snippets. Respect reduced motion and forced colors. Provide a keyboard path for drag or pointer interactions.
